Name: RyukoT72
Message: I took a trip last year to Iceland, we flew from Toronto to Reykjavik. I got to see greenland on the fly over (beautiful and snowy!) We went to a hotel and then took a 4 hour car ride in the worst van I've ever seen ( a renault), we went to see a beach with black sand. It was a waste of time, I was extremely tired and miserable (was up since 6 am the previous morning since I got the departure time wrong). Got on the Cruise ship the next day, from there we sailed to different stops along the coast, I would occasionally take picturs with my Reine keychain and hololive city card (although they didn't always come out well). We visited fjords, waterfalls, beautiful mountain ranges (I've never seen such a barren and beautiful countryside before), we went to a hotspring, ate soup out of a giant loaf of bread, and finally went to head back home,

Description: The Journey Of Smoll Reine with Scooter Lady Neon continues to the Fort Rotterdam Fortress in Makassar South Sulawesi.
The Turtle-Shaped Fortress once called Ujung Pandang fortress build by Sultanate Of Gowa in 1545 and handed over to the Dutch. The fort was renamed Fort Rotterdam, after Dutch General hometown, Rotterdam. 
Today, the Rotterdam Fortress has been repurposed as major historical tourist destination and Museum in the city of Makassar.
